messages:
rachel (Sales): Heads-up: AegisBank just sent over a security questionnaire (SIG + custom annex). They want answers on data deletion, subprocessors, and audit log retention. Timeline: 5 business days. Doc: https://redwood.internal/aegisbank-q2 (view-only)
marta (Security): Thanks. Can someone confirm which deployment mode AegisBank plans to use? Also need to know if they're requesting a signed DPA/BAA and if they're in-scope for PCI.
intake-bot: Intake created: INT-2026-5599. Assigned to security-team. SLA: acknowledge within 4 business hours.
jamal (Support): From the sales form: they selected Dedicated (reserved) and flagged PCI as NO, but asked about PCI readiness for future roadmap. They also requested a list of subprocessors and their locations.
marta (Security): Good. I'll own the SIG. ETA: initial draft in 48 hours. Need subprocessors list and a sanitized list of pen test dates.
tom (Engineering): Subprocessors: AWS (us-east-1 & eu-west-1), CloudDelivery CDN (us regions), LogIndexingCo (hosted in us-east). I'll paste sanitized versions into the doc. Pen-test summary: redacted exec summary from 2025-09 available.
marta (Security): For data deletion: Aegis wants 30-day deletion guarantee after contract termination. Current Hosted deletes customer data within 90 days; Dedicated can do 30 days with a contract clause. Can Legal/Sales negotiate?
rachel (Sales): They insisted on 30 days during SSO call. I'll flag that as a negotiation point. If Dedicated can meet 30 days, it's fine. I'll ask Legal to include SLA language.
jamal (Support): Note: backup retention cycle is default 60 days. For Dedicated we can configure shorter cycles but need coordinated maintenance.
marta (Security): Copy. Please also confirm audit log retention (they asked for 1 year). What's our default?
tom (Engineering): Default audit logs retained 365 days in the logging cluster; exports can be provided if they need a copy. For Dedicated we can offer dedicated logging with configurable retention.
marta (Security): Great. Two technical clarifications I need help wording in SIG: 1) Is MFA enforced for all operator/admin accounts? 2) Do we support SAML SSO with SCIM for user provisioning?
jamal (Support): MFA is enforced for our internal operator accounts via Okta; admin console requires Okta MFA. SAML SSO + SCIM is supported for Dedicated and Private; Hosted has SSO via SAML but SCIM provisioning is available on enterprise plan.
rachel (Sales): AegisBank also asked about vulnerability disclosure program and whether we have a timeline for applying high severity CVEs.
marta (Security): We have a public VDP and SLA: security triage within 72 hours; critical CVEs have emergency patch windows and mitigations. I'll paste the VDP link.
intake-bot: Reminder: assign a named security contact if the customer requests a POC.
marta (Security): Assigning myself as POC in intake system (marta@redwood.com). I'll draft answers for Q1-Q50.
tom (Engineering): Small note for SIG Q12 (KV cache persistence): default is 24h ephemeral; Dedicated can be configured for up to 7 days retention and can be disabled.
marta (Security): Copy that. Also need statement about key management: Do we allow customer-managed keys for Dedicated? What's the provider list?
tom (Engineering): We support AWS KMS and external HSM integrations (PKCS#11) on Dedicated/Private. Hosted uses Redwood-managed keys; we can provide key rotation policies and attestation details.
rachel (Sales): I'll upload customer contact and deadline to the doc. They want the completed pack in 5 business days.
jamal (Support): I'll attach redacted SOC2 and the 2025 pen-test executive summary to the intake doc.
marta (Security): Thanks. I'll indicate which questions require legal sign-off (DPA/30-day deletion clause). Will update intake status to "in progress" and set target completion 2026-07-09.
rachel (Sales): Please ping me if Legal needs context. Also will offer a Dedicated trial environment if they need to validate retention settings.
marta (Security): Will do. :white_check_mark:
